evidence.estrutura: Michel became an anarchist after the Paris Commune and rejected hierarchical state authority, strongly supporting decentralized social organization.
evidence.representacao: She favored revolutionary popular self-government and direct participation rather than elite parliamentary rule; democratic but not conventional representative institutionalism.
evidence.poder: Anarchism, imprisonment and opposition to state repression place her strongly on the anti-coercive side, despite her acceptance of revolutionary force.
evidence.imigracao: Her anarchist internationalism and solidarity with colonized peoples favor pluralism and cross-border solidarity.
evidence.diplomacia: She was a revolutionary willing to participate in armed struggle, so she is not a pacifist despite opposing state militarism.
evidence.intervencao: Anti-imperial and anarchist politics strongly oppose state domination of other peoples, supporting self-determination.
evidence.economia: Her revolutionary anarchism opposed capitalist exploitation and private domination, strongly favoring collective/social ownership.
evidence.controle: Anarchist economics reject centralized state planning even while favoring collective ownership; low-to-moderate centralized control.
evidence.comercio: No conventional tariff doctrine; anarchist internationalism weighs against nationalist protectionism.
evidence.religiao: Her revolutionary anarchism was strongly anti-clerical and secular.
evidence.moral: Women’s emancipation, social equality and revolutionary egalitarianism support progressive social positions.
